models.description: All enabled logical models across enabled providers.

default.description: The resolved install-wide default handle; null when the catalog is empty.

GageModelCatalogDto.description:
The model-discovery catalog every Gage-enabled consuming app pins at startup and is pushed
whenever it changes: all enabled logical models across enabled providers,
plus the resolved Timebase.Pulse.Shared.Gage.GageModelCatalogDto.Default - the full handle of the model an administrator marked
as the install-wide default, or, until one is marked, the alphabetically-first handle - resolved
centrally in Pulse so every consumer receives the same answer. Served by
`GET /api/gage/models` and broadcast verbatim as the hub's `GageCatalogChanged`
message. An empty catalog is a normal response: an empty list and a null default, never an
error.

GageModelDto.description:
One usable model in the discovery catalog: the full handle a caller passes to the
proxy (`providerId/logicalModelId`), its human-friendly display name, and the wire of its
provider - verbatim - so the caller knows which front door to use. Deliberately a strict subset
of what the administrator-only provider catalog exposes: never the API key, the real upstream
model id, the provider endpoint, or the upstream path.

GagePolicyDto.description: A policy as returned to admin clients (client or user; the shape is identical).

GagePolicyRequest.description: Create/update payload for a policy. The id comes from the route.

GageProviderDto.description:
A provider as returned to admin clients. Deliberately omits the raw `ApiKey` - it is never
echoed back - exposing only whether one is set via Timebase.Pulse.Shared.Gage.GageProviderDto.HasApiKey.
Timebase.Pulse.Shared.Gage.GageProviderDto.UpstreamPath is the raw configured value (null when unset, meaning the wire's
canonical path applies), so an editor can distinguish "defaulted" from "configured".

GageProviderRequest.description:
Create/update payload for a provider. Unlike Timebase.Pulse.Shared.Gage.GageProviderDto this carries the raw
Timebase.Pulse.Shared.Gage.GageProviderRequest.ApiKey the admin sets. Timebase.Pulse.Shared.Gage.GageProviderRequest.UpstreamPath is optional - null/empty means
the wire's canonical path.

graceEndsAtUtc.description:
When grace runs out, so a host can say how long is left. Null on a licensed Pulse and on a tier that
declares no grace.

GagePulseLicenseDto.description:
Pulse's licence position, carried on the catalog so a Gage-proxied host can report it without being
able to verify a licence that is not bound to it.

GagePulseLicenseState.description:
Where Pulse's own licence stands. Numbered to match the client-side
`Timebase.Core.Agent.Providers.GagePulseLicenseState`, the way Timebase.Pulse.Domain.Gage.GageWire matches
its client-side copy: the value crosses the wire as a number, so the numbering is the contract.

GageUsagePage.description: A page of usage records plus the total count of the (filtered) set.

LogicalModelDto.description:
A logical model as returned to admin clients. Timebase.Pulse.Shared.Gage.LogicalModelDto.IsDefault is the stored
install-wide default flag, so an editor can round-trip the administrator's choice.

LogicalModelRequest.description:
A logical model in a create/update provider request. Timebase.Pulse.Shared.Gage.LogicalModelRequest.IsDefault marks the
install-wide default model; at most one model in the request may carry it, it must be enabled on
an enabled provider, and the command handler clears the flag on every other provider's models.
Defaults to false so a caller that predates it is unaffected.

MetricLimitDto.description: A metric on a policy, as exchanged over the admin API.

resource.description: This resource's identifier - Pulse's own `/mcp` URL.

authorization_servers.description: Issuer URLs a client may authenticate against; Pulse's `/auth`.

bearer_methods_supported.description: How the token is presented - the Authorization header.

scopes_supported.description:
Advertised for the client to request, matching the set Pulse's own OIDC discovery document
advertises. `offline_access` is what earns a refresh token, but note Pulse issues one based
on the REGISTERED client's scopes rather than the requested scope, so the client registration
must carry it too or the session expires unrenewably.

ProtectedResourceMetadataDocument.description:
The document body. Field names are the wire names from RFC 9728 section 2 and are pinned with
System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonPropertyNameAttribute rather than left to a serializer naming policy, so the
contract does not move if the host's JSON options change.

UsageLogEntryDto.description:
A usage record as returned by the usage query (audit fields only; no internal charges).
CacheReadTokens is the share of PromptTokens served from the
provider's prompt cache, and Estimated flags an entry whose token figures are
the proxy's chars/4 heuristic because the upstream sent no usage accounting.
